content: PyO3 0.27 official parallelism guide (WebFetch; ctx7 unavailable): Python::detach releases the GIL so other Python threads run; ALWAYS wrap code that spawns worker threads (rayon) in detach, otherwise a worker blocking on GIL acquisition while the spawning thread holds it deadlocks. Rayon workers must not hold/acquire the GIL for speedup (unless free-threaded CPython). Python tokens cannot be shared across threads; each thread attaches individually. Corroborated in-repo: pyo3/src/counter.rs uses py.detach (allow_threads deprecated since 0.26) and moves only Send Rust types into closures.
